C0721.title: LinkQ Knowledge Graph System for Mitigating LLM Hallucinations: A Case Study
C0721.summary: A research paper introduces the LinkQ system, which combats hallucinations by forcing large language models to query knowledge graphs for factual data. Quantitative evaluation shows the system outperforms GPT-4 on KGQA datasets but still struggles with certain question categories, indicating that LLMs hallucinate when lacking ground-truth data support.
